shots.name: Upper-Right Flipper
shots.notes: Third full-size flipper, mid-right. Shoots the Library ramp and covers the inner loop / right orbit.

shots.name: Mini Flipper (Quidditch Deck)
shots.notes: The upper deck's own flipper -- the fourth flipper on the machine. Makes the late snitch/broom catch up on the Quidditch deck, then sends the ball out toward the center ramp, near where the Grand Staircase sits.

shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Manual plunger. A full plunge rides up the right side and wraps through the right-orbit lane before dropping to a flipper — the skill-shot level (1/2/3) is pre-selected with the action button before you pull, then the plunge is aimed at whichever shot lights up for that level.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Fawkes ball-save lane once armed by right-orbit shots.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Protego ball-save lane -- armed by inlane HARRY letters, but only while the Golden Trio wand lock is already active.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: One of the HARRY-spelling inlanes; rolling through during normal play advances the Harry letter of the Golden Trio spellout and arms Protego.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: The other HARRY-spelling inlane, paired with the left inlane.

shots.name: Ron Targets (3-Bank)
shots.notes: Three standups, lower-left. Completing the bank spells RON for the Golden Trio wand lock.

shots.name: Hermione Targets (2-Bank)
shots.notes: Two standups directly above the Ron bank, right beside the left ramp. Completing the bank spells HERMIONE for the Golden Trio wand lock.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: First-shot-of-the-game Quidditch qualifier: the opening left-ramp shot sends the ball up to the Quidditch upper playfield to set tryout position. Every left-ramp shot afterward advances Quidditch position/matches instead of climbing the deck again.

shots.name: Library Ramp
shots.notes: Side ramp rising just above the Hermione targets. Builds the end-of-ball bonus multiplier (up to 10x) — the single biggest bonus lever in the game.

shots.name: Death Eater Drop Target
shots.notes: Drops to open the hole behind it. Left side, between the Ron bank and the Whomping Willow.

shots.name: Death Eater Hole
shots.notes: Behind the drop target. The motorized Death Eater sculpt fires the ball back out at you — two duels won here qualifies Death Eater Multiball. Distinct from the Under-Flipper Hole; this one is a violent kickback, not a hidden reach.

shots.name: Whomping Willow
shots.notes: Fully animated tree with the flying Ford Anglia sculpt. Sits over the pop bumpers, upper-center — the car swings as the bumpers fire.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Bumper cluster under the Whomping Willow, upper-center.

shots.name: The Grand Staircase
shots.notes: The signature kinetic sculpture: three entrances, thirteen exits, moving portraits. Rotates between shots so the same physical shot can exit to a different flipper each time. Feeds Explore Hogwarts progress and several hurry-ups; the deck routes to whichever flipper the display calls out before the ball drops.

shots.name: Hagrid Target
shots.notes: Standup between the center ramp and center lane. Cycles the currently-lit Diagon Alley shop and adds green Explore-Hogwarts add-a-ball progress.

shots.name: Center Lane (Great Hall)
shots.notes: The main up-the-middle shot. Repeated hits spell D-I-A-G-O-N to unlock Diagon Alley shops.

shots.name: Scoop
shots.notes: Center VUK. Shoot it while 'Start Term' is lit (lit by the right spinner) to begin a school-year lesson set; later, it's the shot that starts OWLs Multiball and the final wizard mode.

shots.name: Under-Flipper Hole
shots.notes: Under the upper-right flipper -- a blind, easy-to-whiff reach the lead programmer visibly missed several times in a row in the official gameplay video before landing it. Lights for Extra Ball and is one of the Level 2/3 skill-shot picks ('Under flipper').

shots.name: Potion Cauldron
shots.notes: Interactive cauldron sculpture beneath the wand lock — all three locked balls drop through it to start Golden Trio Multiball. Also the Potions-mode entry: any ball that falls in advances the potion-brewing requirement.

shots.name: Allies Target
shots.notes: Standup just below the inner loop. Repeated hits collect Allies (Dumbledore's Army / Order of the Phoenix sub-modes); 10 collected total awards the Locket horcrux.

shots.name: Inner Loop
shots.notes: Upper-middle loop shot. With a Golden Trio letter lit, feeds straight into the wand lock; otherwise loops back down to the right flipper.

shots.name: Wand Multiball Lock
shots.notes: Three life-size wand sculptures (Harry/Ron/Hermione) form the physical 3-ball lock. Fed by the inner loop or the right orbit once a Golden Trio letter is spelled; holds up to three balls before dropping them together through the cauldron to start Golden Trio Multiball.

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: Mirrors the inner loop as the other Golden Trio lock feed; also the usual landing lane for a full plunge. Arms Fawkes (left-outlane save) after enough hits.

shots.name: Right Spinner (Time-Turner)
shots.notes: Spins on right-orbit-adjacent shots. Lights the scoop for 'Start Term' when unlit, and adds time to a running lesson's hourglass when it is.

shots.name: Left Spinner
shots.notes: Left-side spinner in the lane feeding up toward the Whomping Willow bumpers. One of the three spinners whose combined unique-spin count fuels the Hexes & Jinxes ally mode.

shots.name: Center Ramp
shots.notes: Steeper ramp right of the staircase. Second Explore-Hogwarts collection shot and a common combo landing spot for Wizard Travel.

shots.name: Quidditch Spinner
shots.notes: The upper deck's own spinner. Rip it to catch the Golden Snitch (3 catches qualifies Quidditch World Cup Multiball) and to score goals during a running match.

shots.name: Quidditch Position Target
shots.notes: Upper-deck standup used during opening tryouts (and by later potions) to advance Quidditch position beater -> chaser -> keeper -> seeker, which sets your end-of-game Quidditch Bonus multiplier.

goals.title: Skill Shot -- Level 1
goals.summary: The entry-level pick: cycle to it with the action button before you plunge, then land the ball on the lit shot.
goals.reward: Base skill-shot value; collecting it arms Level 2

steps.action: Plunge with Level 1 selected
steps.detail: Tap the action button pre-plunge until the display reads Level 1, then pull. Level 1 is lit across the widest set of targets -- Left Ramp, the Hermione bank, the Death Eater hole, a HARRY inlane, or the Ron bank all qualify.

steps.action: Use the flippers to hit whichever Level 1 target is lit -- Left Ramp is the flagship pick
steps.detail: This one is a flipper shot, not a lucky bounce off the plunge -- you cradle and aim at whichever of the five Level 1 options is flashing when the ball comes down. Left Ramp is the cleanest pick if nothing else is lit yet.

goals.title: Skill Shot -- Level 2
goals.summary: Collecting Level 1 arms Level 2, which trades the easy options for a longer list that reaches deeper into the playfield -- including the Grand Staircase and the Under-Flipper Hole.
goals.reward: Higher skill-shot value; arms Level 3

steps.action: Plunge with Level 2 selected
steps.detail: Cycle to Level 2 with the action button. It shares most of Level 1's list plus the Staircase, the right orbit, the Under-Flipper Hole, and the center ramp.

steps.action: Land on the lit Level 2 shot -- Staircase is the flagship pick
steps.detail: The Grand Staircase is one of the marquee Level 2 options; whichever shot is actually flashing when the ball arrives is the one that scores.

goals.title: Skill Shot -- Level 3
goals.summary: The advanced tier: fewer options, all of them precise. Center ramp, the Under-Flipper Hole, and the right spinner headline a short, harder list. Level 2 has to be banked before this tier is on offer.
goals.reward: Top skill-shot value

steps.action: Plunge with Level 3 selected
steps.detail: Cycle to Level 3. The list shrinks to center lane, center ramp, the Under-Flipper Hole, the right spinner, and progress toward Dumbledore's Army.

steps.action: Land on the lit Level 3 shot -- center ramp is the flagship pick
steps.detail: Center ramp is the cleanest Level 3 target off a full plunge; land on whichever shot is actually lit.

goals.title: Golden Trio Multiball
goals.summary: Spell all three names -- HARRY at the inlanes, RON at the left 3-bank, HERMIONE at the left 2-bank -- to lock a ball at the wand sculpture for each. Three balls locked starts the multiball and drops them together through the cauldron.
goals.reward: Character jackpots (blue/Ron, red/Harry, yellow/Hermione) + escalating Wand Jackpots at 2x/3x; Super Jackpot after the third

steps.action: Roll the inlanes to spell HARRY
steps.detail: Either inlane counts; a completed HARRY locks a ball at the wand sculptures.

steps.action: Complete the left 3-bank to spell RON
steps.detail: Locks a second ball at the wands once finished.

steps.action: Complete the left 2-bank to spell HERMIONE
steps.detail: Locks the third ball -- three locked balls drop through the cauldron and the multiball begins.

steps.action: Send a spelled letter's ball to the wand lock via the inner loop
steps.detail: Inner loop and right orbit both feed the physical wand lockup once a name is complete.

steps.action: All three locks drop through the cauldron to start
steps.detail: Multiball begins with all three balls in play.

steps.action: Collect character jackpots at their color's shot, then chase the Wand Jackpot
steps.detail: Hitting a character's own target after their color jackpot relights that color; three same-color jackpots light the Wand Jackpot at the inner loop, center lane, or right orbit -- second Wand Jackpot pays 2x, third pays 3x and opens a 45-second Super Jackpot window.

goals.title: Quidditch World Cup Multiball
goals.summary: Your very first left-ramp shot sends you to the upper deck to set your Quidditch position. From then on, rip the deck spinner to catch the Snitch three separate matches to qualify the World Cup, then shoot the left ramp to start it.
goals.reward: Green (Ireland) and red (Bulgaria) jackpots; 5 jackpots lights a loopable, escalating Super Jackpot (up to 5x) on the upper-deck ramp -- awards the Diadem horcrux

steps.action: Take the opening left-ramp shot to reach the upper deck
steps.detail: Only the very first left-ramp shot of the game climbs the deck for tryouts -- every later left-ramp shot advances position or starts a match instead.

steps.action: Clear tryout targets to set your starting position
steps.detail: More clears mean a better position (beater -> chaser -> keeper -> seeker), which raises your end-of-game Quidditch Bonus.

steps.action: Rip the deck spinner to catch the Snitch, three matches running
steps.detail: A caught Snitch ends the match in your favor; three qualifying matches lights the World Cup at the left ramp.

steps.action: Shoot the left ramp to start Quidditch World Cup Multiball
steps.detail: Now a genuine multiball -- balls loop through the main playfield rather than climbing the deck again.

steps.action: Collect green and red jackpots, then chase the Super Jackpot
steps.detail: 5 jackpots light a roving Super Jackpot on the upper-deck ramp that pays more each additional loop, up to 5x -- awards the Diadem horcrux.

goals.title: Explore Hogwarts Multiball
goals.summary: Eight banners sit across the top of the display -- four houses, four castle features. Shoot the center ramp and the staircase to lower them; the green pair and the yellow pair (four of the eight) already start spotted, so as few as two solid shots can qualify the very first multiball.
goals.reward: Four jackpot families (Secret Passages, Classrooms, Castle Grounds, Towers); 4 jackpots lights an escalating, roving Super Jackpot -- awards the Ring horcrux

steps.action: Shoot the center ramp to lower house and castle banners
steps.detail: Green and yellow start already lowered, so two clean shots between the center ramp and the staircase can be enough to qualify.

steps.action: Shoot the Grand Staircase for the rest of the banners
steps.detail: Staircase and center lane both count toward the same eight-banner set.

steps.action: With all eight down, shoot the staircase to start
steps.detail: Two-ball multiball; an add-a-ball lights green at the Hagrid target after two jackpots.

steps.action: Collect jackpots at lit shots, then chase the roving Super Jackpot
steps.detail: Four jackpots light an escalating Super Jackpot that keeps roving shot to shot -- it stays lit into your next ball even if the multiball itself ends first.

goals.title: Death Eater Multiball
goals.summary: Beat two Death Eaters in single combat before the multiball even starts: shoot the drop target, then the hole behind it while it's open, twice each. The second win throws the flippers dark for a moment and the multiball begins.
goals.reward: A four-stage escalating hurry-up-into-jackpots-into-frenzy structure; first Death Eater defeated lights an Extra Ball

steps.action: Drop the target to open the hole
steps.detail: Standard drop target, left side.

steps.action: Shoot the open hole twice within 20 seconds to defeat a Death Eater
steps.detail: The motorized sculpt fires the ball back at you between hits -- awards 20M and, the first time, an Extra Ball.

steps.action: Repeat the drop-and-duel for a second Death Eater
steps.detail: Beating the second one starts the multiball outright.

steps.action: Run the hurry-up, then the green jackpots, then the frenzy
steps.detail: Hurry-up value steps down the Death Eater health requirement at 800K and 400K; green shots after that are jackpots at half health; late-stage right-side shots (scoop, right spinner, behind the flipper) are Super Jackpots worth 5M per Death Eater already killed.

goals.title: O.W.L.s Multiball
goals.summary: Finish a Final Exam -- six lessons completed for that school year -- and O.W.L.s lights at the center lane. Each spell you finished at Ollivander's along the way is baked into the jackpot multiplier before the ball even drops.
goals.reward: 2-ball multiball, 30s ball save; base jackpot scales with lessons completed (8 lessons ~= 19M); 5 jackpots lights a Super, and 65 switch hits during it triples the next one

steps.action: Start a school year and clear its Fall Term lessons
steps.detail: Shoot lit red/gold shots within each lesson's timer; five lessons make up a Fall Term.

steps.action: Clear the Spring Term lessons the same way
steps.detail: Five more timed lessons -- ten total between the two terms.

steps.action: Finish the six-lesson Final Exam
steps.detail: Completing it lights O.W.L.s Multiball right up the middle.

steps.action: Shoot the center lane to start O.W.L.s
steps.detail: Jackpot value is already set by how many lessons you completed on the way in.

steps.action: Complete Flourish & Blotts spell-memory rounds beforehand for a fatter multiplier
steps.detail: Each spell finished at the Diagon Alley bookshop adds a permanent +1x that carries into O.W.L.s.

steps.action: Collect 5 red jackpots, then push for the triple Super
steps.detail: Five jackpots lights the Super; 65 total switch hits during the multiball upgrades the next jackpot to triple.

goals.title: Diagon Alley: Visit a Shop
goals.summary: Repeated center-lane hits spell D-I-A-G-O-N; finishing it lets you pick one of four open shops (a fifth, Borgin & Burkes, unlocks later). Ollivander's is the one that feeds Golden Trio the hardest -- start there.
goals.reward: Ollivander's: choice of Golden Trio perks (longer ball save / bigger jackpots / easier Wand Jackpots / 2x-3x combos / auto-restart); other shops pay cash, hurry-ups, or Bombtastic Bombs

steps.action: Shoot the center lane repeatedly to spell D-I-A-G-O-N
steps.detail: It takes three center-lane hits to spell it out, plus one more for each shop you've already visited, capping at six; finishing the word unlocks entry to one of the four base shops.

steps.action: Cycle to the shop you want with the Hagrid target or the action button
steps.detail: Whichever shop is flashing is the one your next qualifying shot enters.

steps.action: Enter Ollivander's and shoot the flashing double-arrow shots
steps.detail: A 30-second timed mode; each shot made banks one of five Golden Trio Multiball perks for later in the game.

goals.title: Collect Allies: Dumbledore's Army / Order of the Phoenix
goals.summary: Repeated hits on the Allies target under the inner loop cycle through four short timed sub-modes at the inner loop and right orbit. Ten allies collected total, with all four sub-modes played along the way, awards the Locket horcrux.
goals.reward: Escalating-value repeat shots per sub-mode; 10th ally awards the Locket horcrux

steps.action: Hit the Allies target to arm the next sub-mode
steps.detail: Cycles between Luna Loves Loops and Loopin' Lupin (inner loop / right orbit repeats), Hexes & Jinxes (all three spinners), and Heart's Desire (feed the bumpers).

steps.action: Luna Loves Loops: repeat the inner loop for 30 seconds
steps.detail: Each repeat scores more than the last.

steps.action: Loopin' Lupin: repeat the right orbit for 30 seconds
steps.detail: Same escalating-repeat structure, mirrored to the right side.

steps.action: Hexes & Jinxes: spin all three spinners for unique combinations
steps.detail: Left spinner, right spinner, and the Quidditch deck spinner all count toward the total.

steps.action: Heart's Desire: feed the pop bumpers via center lane or staircase
steps.detail: Each bumper hit while the mode runs adds value; the Mirror of Erised shows your reflection on the display.

goals.title: Wizard Travel: Build Geminio
goals.summary: Chain lit shots in quick succession anywhere on the table -- the insert in front of the scoop flashes when a combo is ready to extend. Each level of Wizard Travel hands out a real reward, and Geminio itself is the game's playfield-wide multiplier.
goals.reward: L2/L5/L8 arm Geminio at 2x/3x/4x for 30 seconds; L3/L4 light an Extra Ball; L6 is Extra Credit Mania; L7 is a Special

steps.action: Open a combo on any lit shot
steps.detail: The scoop-front insert flashes the instant you're within combo range of another lit shot.

steps.action: Chain a second shot immediately
steps.detail: Speed matters more than which shots -- the combo window is short.

steps.action: Keep the chain alive on a third shot to bank a Wizard Travel level
steps.detail: Every level completed advances the ladder from Broomstick up toward Apparition.

steps.action: At Level 2, 5, or 8, cash the charm for a full-field Geminio multiplier
steps.detail: Geminio covers the display in trophies and multiplies every switch hit for 30 seconds -- its value climbs each time you trigger it in the same game.

goals.title: Potions: Brew a Mystery Award
goals.summary: Any ball that drops into the cauldron starts a potion. The display offers three awards mapped to the left ramp, center ramp, and right orbit -- shoot one to lock it in, then hit that same shot twice more to collect.
goals.reward: One of twenty-plus possible awards, from a simple ball save to spotting a horcrux outright

steps.action: Drop a ball into the cauldron to arm a potion
steps.detail: The requirement grows by one hole-shot each time you restart the mode.

steps.action: Shoot one of the three lit shots to lock in its award
steps.detail: Left ramp, center ramp, and right orbit each carry a different potion on the display.

steps.action: Hit that same shot twice more to collect
steps.detail: Locking in doesn't pay by itself -- you have to return to the same shot two more times.

goals.title: Potter Frenzy
goals.summary: Spell HARRY at the inlanes four separate times in a game -- it doesn't matter whether Golden Trio is already locked or not -- and every switch in the game scores big for 40 seconds while the cast shouts 'Potter!'
goals.reward: Every switch hit scores a random 50K-100K for 40 seconds

steps.action: Roll HARRY at the inlanes a fourth time this game
steps.detail: Golden Trio lock status doesn't matter -- this is a separate counter that just needs four completed HARRYs.

steps.action: Once it starts, hit anything -- bumpers are the fastest filler
steps.detail: Every switch in the building pays out for the full 40 seconds; there's no wrong shot here.

goals.title: Fawkes: Arm the Left Outlane Save
goals.summary: Enough right-orbit hits lights Fawkes at the left outlane. Drain there and you get one shot at redemption: three different shots in 20 seconds, or the ball stays gone.
goals.reward: A saved ball plus a 10-second victory lap on each shot you complete; finishing all three lights a Super Jackpot

steps.action: Build right-orbit hits to arm Fawkes
steps.detail: Once armed, a left-outlane drain triggers the save instead of ending the ball.

steps.action: Drain left to trigger the save
steps.detail: Not a shot you aim for on purpose -- Fawkes turns an unlucky bounce into a second chance.

steps.action: Hit three different shots within 20 seconds to complete the save
steps.detail: Each unique shot made extends the window another 10 seconds; complete all three and a Super Jackpot lights.

goals.title: Protego: Arm the Right Outlane Shield
goals.summary: Rolling HARRY at the inlanes lights Protego at the right outlane, but only once the Golden Trio wand lock is already active -- after that it's a simple, no-challenge save that just sits there ready.
goals.reward: Any right-outlane drain while lit is saved automatically, no extra shots required

steps.action: Spell HARRY at the inlanes while the Golden Trio lock is already lit
steps.detail: Only counts while the Golden Trio wand lock is active; once armed, it lights colored LEDs below the shield insert at the right outlane.

steps.action: Drain right while lit -- the gate saves it for you
steps.detail: Even a weak right-spinner dribble down the outlane during a ball save doesn't burn Protego.

goals.title: Play a School-Year Lesson
goals.summary: Every year at Hogwarts breaks into a Fall Term, a Spring Term, and a Final Exam -- each a run of short, movie-scene lessons you clear by shooting whatever's blinking red and gold before the hourglass runs out.
instructions: Shoot the scoop while 'Start Term' is lit (the right spinner lights it) and pick your year with the flipper buttons and the action button
Watch for shots blinking red and gold -- those are the current lesson's targets, and they change from lesson to lesson within the same movie
Clear the lesson before its on-screen hourglass runs out, or it times out and the game moves you on anyway
The right spinner is your Time-Turner: rip it mid-lesson to add seconds to a tight timer
A Bombtastic Bomb from Weasley's Wizard Wheezes instantly clears whatever lesson is running if you press the action button
Clearing lessons back-to-back (no drains, no timeouts) pays a streak bonus on top of each lesson's own reward
Six lessons make a Final Exam; finishing one lights O.W.L.s Multiball at the center lane
goals.reward: Time bonus (seconds left x25K, plus 25K per lesson cleared in a row); a finished Final Exam lights O.W.L.s

goals.title: Destroy Every Horcrux
goals.summary: Seven horcruxes are scattered across the game's biggest features -- one per multiball super jackpot, one for the ally sweep, one for the Diagon Alley bookshop, and one for surviving the Deathly Hallows mini-wizard. All seven lights the final wizard mode.

steps.action: Diary: finish the spell-memory game at Flourish & Blotts
steps.detail: Diagon Alley bookshop mode -- memorize and repeat a spell sequence on the flippers.

steps.action: Ring: score the Super Jackpot in Explore Hogwarts Multiball
Locket: collect ten Allies, playing all four sub-modes along the way
Cup: score the Super Jackpot in Golden Trio Multiball
Diadem: score the Super Jackpot in Quidditch World Cup Multiball
Harry: clear all three Deathly Hallows in the mini-wizard mode
Nagini: start Death Eater Multiball

goals.reward: All seven lights The Boy Who Lived at the center lane

goals.title: Mini-Wizard: The Deathly Hallows
goals.summary: Earn all three Hallows through ordinary play -- HARRY x3 at the inlanes, 200 Quidditch points, and four lessons in one term -- and the scoop lights for a 90-second three-item chase with a real playfield multiplier riding on it.
goals.reward: Each item collected pays 50M-100M x the running multiplier, plus an extra ball and bonus seconds; the third item awards the Harry horcrux

steps.action: Qualify the Invisibility Cloak: spell HARRY three times
Qualify the Resurrection Stone: reach 200 Quidditch points
Qualify the Elder Wand: clear four lessons in one term
With any set qualified, shoot the scoop to start
steps.detail: 90 seconds on the clock, 18-second ball save.

steps.action: Collect blue shots for the Cloak, purple for the Stone, red for the Wand
steps.detail: Five hits each; the upper-deck spinner can be looped repeatedly for the Stone's purple count.

steps.action: Yellow shots advance the Three Brothers story and the playfield multiplier
steps.detail: Each story beat adds +0.25x, up to 8x total.

goals.title: Mini-Wizard: The Battle of Hogwarts
goals.summary: Play any four of the five main multiballs in one game and this six-ball mini-wizard lights. Five staged badges count down as you complete banks of spinners, targets, ramps, bumpers, and orbits -- lose it down to one ball and it's over.
goals.reward: 25M / 50M / 75M for stages 1-3; a timed Protego shield is available under the upper-right flipper throughout

steps.action: Play any four of the five multiballs -- Golden Trio, Quidditch World Cup, Explore Hogwarts, Death Eater, or O.W.L.s -- in the same game
steps.detail: Started counts -- they don't all need to be completed.

steps.action: Start the mini-wizard when nothing else is running
steps.detail: Begins with six balls in play.

steps.action: Clear a mix of spinner, target, ramp, bumper, and orbit hits each stage
steps.detail: Requirements loosen as balls drain -- stage 2 might only need 3 of 5 feature types cleared.

steps.action: Shoot under the upper-right flipper to arm a 15-second Protego shield
steps.detail: Buys you time to keep multiple balls alive as the mode tightens.

goals.title: Final Wizard: The Boy Who Lived
goals.summary: All seven horcruxes down lights the center lane for the endgame: destroy each horcrux in movie order, then finish Voldemort himself.
goals.reward: The game's biggest single-mode payout; a win is the top of the achievement ladder

steps.action: Shoot the center lane with all seven horcruxes collected
Diary: two orange shots
Ring: three purple shots
Locket: four pink shots
Cup: three white shots -- plays as its own multiball
Diadem: three blue shots
Harry: three red shots
Nagini, then Voldemort: destroying the seventh horcrux starts the final duel
steps.detail: Beat the duel to win the game's top wizard mode.

goals.title: Secret: The Game Changer Difficulty Select
goals.summary: A patent-pending JJP feature hiding in plain sight at the start of every game: scan the QR code on the included fob (or use the on-screen prompt) to hand-pick how forgiving the ruleset is before you ever touch the plunger.
instructions: Before starting a game, scan the QR code on the Harry Potter fob with a phone, or step through the operator-facing prompt on the cabinet
Choose Easy, Normal, or Wizard -- the choice re-tunes ball saves, timers, and requirements across the whole ruleset for that game
Easy is built for newer players and kids; Wizard tightens everything back down for competitive play
The setting only applies for the game you start immediately after choosing it
goals.reward: A full difficulty re-tune (ball saves, timers, requirements) without touching the coin door

goals.title: Strategy: First Ball, Keep It Simple
goals.summary: Land an easy skill shot, get a school year running immediately so it keeps paying while you do other things, then bank a couple of Death Eater duels for the extra ball before you go looking for trouble.

steps.action: Take the Level 1 skill shot
steps.detail: Widest target list on offer -- easiest of the three to land clean.

steps.action: Start a school year immediately
steps.detail: Lessons run in the background and reward you for shots you'd be taking anyway.

steps.action: Work the Death Eater duel between other shots
steps.detail: Beating the first one lights an extra ball -- a safe, repeatable early goal.

steps.action: Take your opening left-ramp shot for Quidditch position
steps.detail: Only the very first one counts for tryouts, so don't waste it on a rebound.

goals.title: Strategy: The Efficient Line
goals.summary: Bank Ollivander's perks before you ever lock a ball, keep a lesson running at all times for free value, and time Golden Trio to land while Explore Hogwarts' Super Jackpot is still roving so one shot can double-dip.

steps.action: Spell D-I-A-G-O-N early and take Ollivander's first
steps.detail: Bank the Golden Trio perks -- longer ball save and easier Wand Jackpots pay off on every multiball after this one.

steps.action: Keep a lesson running continuously
steps.detail: Idle shots you'd make anyway count toward lesson clears -- there's no reason to ever have Start Term sitting unlit.

steps.action: Get Explore Hogwarts' Super Jackpot roving before you finish Golden Trio
steps.detail: A roving Super stays lit into the next multiball you start -- stack it under Golden Trio and collect twice for one qualifying run.

steps.action: Chain combos toward Wizard Travel Level 2 for an early Geminio
steps.detail: A 2x field multiplier this early compounds everything that follows.

steps.action: Bank library-ramp hits for bonus multiplier between bigger plays
steps.detail: Cheap, safe value that adds up over a full game.

achievements.title: Advanced Placement
achievements.desc: Work the leveled skill shot all the way to Level 3 and land it in a single game.

achievements.title: The Trio Assembles

drills.title: Skill Shot Ladder
drills.text: Cycle through all three skill-shot levels back to back on fresh plunges. Get a feel for how far a full plunge actually carries and which shot lights for which level before you start caring about the reward -- both inlanes count as a valid HARRY-lane pick at Level 1.

drills.title: Under-Flipper Hole Reps
drills.text: From a cradled ball on the upper-right flipper, work the blind reach into the Under-Flipper Hole. This is the shot the game's own programmer whiffed repeatedly on camera -- expect the same.

drills.title: Death Eater Duel, Start to Finish
drills.text: Drop the target, shoot the hole, catch the kickback, repeat until a Death Eater is down. Do it twice in a row without missing a drop-target hit.

drills.title: Wand Lock: Both Feeds
drills.text: Alternate inner-loop and right-orbit shots with a Golden Trio letter lit, so you're comfortable feeding the lock from either side rather than only your favorite.

drills.title: Wizard Travel Chain
drills.text: String three lit shots together as fast as you can manage without a flipper hesitation in between. Track how many Wizard Travel levels you can bank in a single ball.

drills.title: Whomping Willow Bumper Feed
drills.text: Feed the pop bumpers under the animated Whomping Willow from the center lane or the staircase and just watch where the ball tends to come out. The tree's swinging branches add enough extra chaos that a blind flip on the exit drains more often than it should.

actionButton.label: Action Button
actionButton.location: center of the lockdown bar; RGB-lit, with a laser-cut spell-form applique on the Collector's Edition
actionButton.how: On this one the button is a chooser, not a weapon -- nearly everything it does is picking between options the game is already offering you. You press it before a plunge to set your skill-shot level, at the scoop to pick a school year, and mid-lesson to cash a Bombtastic Bomb. Several of those jobs run against a timer, so practice finding it without looking down.

uses.when: Ball waiting in the shooter lane
uses.what: Each tap moves the lit skill shot between Level 1, 2 and 3 before you pull the plunger.
Works with the flipper buttons to choose which school year and term you take on next.

uses.when: After spelling DIAGON at the center lane
uses.what: Steps the lit Diagon Alley shop directly, instead of waiting on Hagrid target hits to rotate it.
Spends one Bomb and instantly completes whatever lesson is running, hourglass and all.
Changes the selected book; with the ball in the shooter lane you must hold the left flipper while pressing.

uses.when: During the Flourish & Blotts spell test
uses.what: Supplies inputs alongside the flippers as you repeat the memorized spell order for an O.W.L.s multiplier.

howItPlays.objective: Harry Potter is Jersey Jack's sprawling castle machine built around seven horcruxes, one banked from each of its biggest features. Assemble the Golden Trio, work through Hogwarts classes and multiballs, and destroy every horcrux to reach The Boy Who Lived.
loop: Spell HARRY at the inlanes, RON on the left three-bank, and HERMIONE on the two-bank to lock balls at the wands and drop them through the cauldron for Golden Trio Multiball.
Shoot the scoop to start a school year, then clear its blinking red-and-gold lessons before the hourglass empties to build toward O.W.L.s.
Feed the center ramp and the Grand Staircase to lower castle banners, take the opening left ramp up to the Quidditch deck, and duel the Death Eaters -- each feature banks a horcrux.
Chain lit shots for Wizard Travel to arm the Geminio field multiplier, and collect all seven horcruxes to open the final wizard mode, The Boy Who Lived, up the center lane.

lights.name: Golden Trio Names
lights.lit: A lit insert is a name letter you have not collected yet -- HARRY rides the two inlanes, RON the lower-left three-bank, HERMIONE the two-bank -- and each completed name locks a ball at its wand sculpture and stays locked.
lights.then: Feed the inner loop or right orbit once a name is done to bank each locked ball, and the third lock sends all three tumbling down through the cauldron to begin the multiball. Chase three same-color character jackpots to light the Wand Jackpot, which climbs to 3x and opens a Super Jackpot window that awards the Cup horcrux.

lights.name: Diagon Alley Letters
lights.lit: Each center-lane shot lights another letter of D-I-A-G-O-N, the word holds its progress between shots, and finishing it opens one of Diagon Alley's shops.

control.effect: press to step the lit shop straight to the one you want -- the Hagrid target rotates it too -- so your next qualifying shot enters that shop
control.when: after D-I-A-G-O-N is spelled at the center lane

lights.then: Take Ollivander's first and shoot its flashing double-arrow shots inside the timer to bank Golden Trio perks -- longer ball saves and easier Wand Jackpots that pay off in every later multiball. The bookshop's spell-memory game hands over the Diary horcrux.

lights.name: Explore Hogwarts Banners
lights.lit: Eight banners across the top of the display are the four houses and four castle features, with the green and yellow pairs starting already lowered, so a lit banner is just one still standing.
lights.then: Knock the banners down with the center ramp and the Grand Staircase, then shoot the staircase to start a two-ball multiball. Four jackpots light a roving Super that stays lit into your next ball and awards the Ring horcrux.

lights.name: Quidditch Deck
lights.lit: Your very first left-ramp shot climbs to the upper deck for tryouts, and from then on the deck spinner lights when the Golden Snitch can be caught during a match.
lights.then: Clear the tryout target to raise your position from beater up to seeker for a bigger end-of-game bonus, then work the upper-deck spinner to snare the Golden Snitch across three separate matches. A third catch arms the World Cup back on the left ramp, whose Super Jackpot awards the Diadem horcrux.

lights.name: Death Eater Duel
lights.lit: The Death Eater drop target guards a hole; dropping it opens the hole for a duel, and a lit hole means a Death Eater is waiting there.
lights.then: Shoot the open hole twice inside the timer to win a duel -- the motorized Death Eater kicks the ball hard back at you between the two hits -- and the first win lights an Extra Ball. Beat a second Death Eater to start the multiball outright and bank the Nagini horcrux.

lights.name: School-Year Lessons
lights.lit: The scoop lights for Start Term whenever the right spinner is ripped, and inside a lesson the blinking red-and-gold shots are the current targets, changing from lesson to lesson.

control.effect: press it with the flipper buttons to choose the year and term you play next
control.when: with Start Term lit at the scoop

lights.then: Clear the blinking shots before the hourglass empties -- rip the right spinner as a Time-Turner to buy seconds -- and stack lessons back to back for a streak bonus. Six lessons finish a Final Exam and light O.W.L.s Multiball at the center lane, its jackpot already fattened by every lesson you cleared.

lights.name: Collect the Allies
lights.lit: The Allies standup under the inner loop lights to arm the next of four short ally sub-modes, each played at the loops, the spinners, or the bumpers.
lights.then: Hit the Allies target to start a sub-mode, then repeat its lit shot -- the inner loop, the right orbit, the three spinners, or the pop bumpers -- for escalating value. Collect ten allies across all four sub-modes to claim the Locket horcrux.

lights.name: Wizard Travel & Geminio
lights.lit: A combo insert by the scoop lights up the moment a second lit shot sits close enough to chain into, marking a combo ready to extend.
lights.flashing: A flashing combo insert is a live window, so speed matters more than which shot you take next.
lights.then: String lit shots together to climb the Wizard Travel ladder, which hands out Extra Balls, an Extra Credit round, and a Special along the way. Levels two, five, and eight arm Geminio, a thirty-second field multiplier that doubles, triples, then quadruples every switch and grows each time you fire it.

scoring.text: Take an easy Level 1 skill shot, then shoot the scoop to get a school year running so lessons pay you for shots you would take anyway. Work the Death Eater drop-and-duel between everything else, since the first win hands you an Extra Ball.

Spell D-I-A-G-O-N and bank Ollivander's perks before you lock a ball, then assemble the Golden Trio and lower the castle banners for Explore Hogwarts. Chain combos to an early Geminio so a field multiplier is compounding everything that follows.

Every major feature banks one of seven horcruxes; collect them all to open the endgame, The Boy Who Lived, up the center lane and duel Voldemort for the game's biggest payout. The six-ball Battle of Hogwarts and the Deathly Hallows chase sit just below it as the marquee mini-wizards.
